notes: case_holdout: empty set in splits/flood.json (nothing to evaluate).

Sample set is the FLOOD-13 balanced sample (1/3 positive, 1/3 hard-negative, 1/3 wet patches; seed 0), built exactly as for val from the frozen split ids; pixel prevalence is ~5 % and is NOT the true base rate. AUPRC and Brier are only comparable within this sample; calibrated probabilities are calibrated to the balanced val sample (isotonic, frozen), not to climatology.

Scored pixels: ring (y == -1) and valid == 0 pixels dropped. Thresholded metrics (pixel CSI/POD/FAR, neighbourhood CSI radius 2, event POD, hard-negative alarm rate) use a fixed p >= 0.5, not tuned; event POD = fraction of positive patches with an alarm pixel in the positive footprint (patch footprints, not individual reports).

CI = day-block bootstrap over UTC issue days of the patches (per-day sufficient statistics); AUPRC/ROC from 2000 sqrt-spaced score bins (error ~1e-4). Single training seed: CI covers test sampling only, not training variance.

flood.unet = frozen isotonic-calibrated U-Net (shipped model); flood.unet_raw = same net uncalibrated. Isotonic ties cost about 0.003 AUPRC on val. FLASH ablation (no_flash) was within seed noise on val.
Logistic regression refit on TRAIN only from a streamed uniform 2 M-pixel subsample (seed 0); its random subset differs from logs/flood_baselines_val.json, so small differences are expected.
Rule baselines are {0,1} predictors: AUPRC is a single operating point; Brier/ECE are not reported meaningfully for them (ECE omitted).
No published reference number exists for this patch set; no reference row.
case_holdout is empty for flood (quarantine touches no flood sample, T14).
